the field-effect mobility and stability of IZO TFTs are improved by germanium doping.

germanium (Ge) substitution for zinc ( Zn) in solution-processed indi um-zinc-oxide thin films increases their carrier concentration and thus the performance of the resulting thin-film transis tors (TFTs).
Ge doping increases the carrier concentration of IZO thin films by Ge substitution for Zn, resulting in a higher field-effect mobility of Ge-doped solution-processed IZO thin-film transitors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel method for the preparation of Ge-doped solution-processed indum-zinc-oxide thin-film transitors.
a new type of oxide TFT that is suitable for flexible displays, and the Ge-doping mechanism in IZO TFTs is also discussed.

the development of a new solution processable transparent conducting material, which has the potential for use as a replacement for indium tin oxide (ITO), which is the current standard for transparent electrodes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the substitution of Zn by Ge is possible and that the electrical properties of IZO are significantly improved.
the Ge doping effects on the electrical performance and stability of IZO TFTs are mainly caused by the replacement and rearrangement of the oxide lattice by Ge doping.
Ge doping in IZO TFTs can be used to replace and rearrange the oxide lattice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ge-doped IZOs are promising for the next-generation flexible electronics.
we successfully developed a new solution-processed IZO TFT with improved device performances, by using Ge-doping.
Ge substitution for Zn in the active layer of solution-processed IZO TFTs can improve the electrical properties of the devices, thus making them suitable for flexible display applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Ge substitution for Zn in the active layer of IZO TFTs is the main mechanism that enhances the device performance, which is different from the conventional Ge doping in oxide semiconductor thin films.
Ge doping in IZO TFTs can be achieved by the substitution of Ge atoms for Zn atoms.
Ge doping can improve the performance of TFTs, even if they have a quaternary composition.
